decisions.source_name: Sporobolus neglectus var. ozarkanus (Fernald) Steyerm. & C.L.Kucera
decisions.action: Under current POWO/WCVP, this historical name resolves to S. neglectus, not canonical S. vaginiflorus. Preserve alternative FNA/ITIS/Weakley concepts separately.

decisions.source_name: Auto-merge S. vaginiflorus var. ozarkanus into S. vaginiflorus
decisions.action: POWO maps var. ozarkanus to S. neglectus; FNA/ITIS place it within S. vaginiflorus and Weakley 2025 recognizes S. ozarkanus. Do not silently merge.

decisions.source_name: Promote S. vaginiflorus var. inaequalis or var. minor as currently accepted Kew varieties
decisions.action: Both names are synonyms under POWO/WCVP, not accepted Kew varieties.

decisions.source_name: Treat Sporobolus minor Vasey as an accepted species
decisions.action: Vasey's name is an illegitimate later homonym, not an accepted independent species.

decisions.source_name: Existing learner photo or herbarium determination within the vaginiflorus/neglectus/ozarkanus complex
decisions.action: Name synonymy does not establish the identity of an individual plant; preserve existing identification and microcharacter holds, no photo relabeling.

decisions.source_name: Unverified hybrid or introgressed ancestry in the complex
decisions.action: No genetic or specimen-specific evidence establishing hybrid parentage was reviewed; do not assign a hybrid or remove an existing hold.

decisions.source_name: Historical ozarkanus-labelled observation lacking original taxonomic concept and diagnostic voucher
decisions.action: Require source, rank, date, voucher and diagnostic lemma/glume evidence before assigning a particular observation to the Kew, FNA/ITIS or Weakley concept.

decisions.source_name: Taxonomic rank and circumscription of Sporobolus ozarkanus
decisions.action: Kew sinks S. ozarkanus and var. ozarkanus into S. neglectus; FNA 2003 and ITIS accept S. vaginiflorus var. ozarkanus; Weakley 2025 recognizes S. ozarkanus as species. Preserve authority-qualified concepts; no canonical split.

POWO overview says perennial, but FNA's species treatment explicitly says annual. This is a source metadata discrepancy, not a reason to change accepted species identity; do not propagate the perennial claim.
